# PugliAI

> PugliAI S.r.l. is an Italian AI consulting and implementation company focused on small and medium-sized businesses. This directory points to its published services, products and educational content in Italian and English.

Updated: 2026-11-13. The linked pages contain the current scope, pricing and qualifications for each offering.

## Company and contact

- Legal name: PugliAI S.r.l.
- Founded: 2023.
- Founder and CEO: Gregor Marić.
- VAT number: IT02735920742. REA: BR-170874.
- Headquarters: Via Giovanni Forleo 45, 72022 Latiano (BR), Italy.
- Northern Italy office: Via Angelo Maj 16, 24121 Bergamo (BG), Italy.
- Email: sales@pugliai.com. No public telephone number is listed.
- [About PugliAI](https://pugliai.com/chi-siamo.html) / [English](https://pugliai.com/en/about-us.html)
- [Founder](https://pugliai.com/gregor-maric.html) / [English](https://pugliai.com/en/gregor-maric.html)

## Services and published pricing

PugliAI publishes consulting programmes covering assessment, implementation, team training and measurement. Scope and terms depend on the selected engagement; list prices below exclude VAT.

| Programme | Published price | Duration |
|-----------|-----------------|----------|
| AI Accelerator | €15,000–25,000 | 3 months |
| AI Transformation | €50,000–70,000 | 6 months |
| AI Partnership | €100,000+ | 12 months |

- [Services and programme terms](https://pugliai.com/servizi.html) / [English](https://pugliai.com/en/services.html)

## Products

- [VoiceAI On-Premise](https://pugliai.com/voiceai-on-premise.html) / [English](https://pugliai.com/en/voiceai-on-premise.html): voice assistant, call routing and transcription. Published tiers: €25,000 Starter, €45,000 Business, Enterprise from €75,000.
- [KnowledgeAI Enterprise](https://pugliai.com/knowledgeai-enterprise.html) / [English](https://pugliai.com/en/knowledgeai-enterprise.html): document retrieval and question answering with RAG, source references and access permissions. Published tiers: €30,000 Team, €55,000 Business, Enterprise from €85,000.
- [MCP hosting](https://pugliai.com/hosting-mcp.html) / [English](https://pugliai.com/en/mcp-hosting.html): installation and management of Model Context Protocol servers connecting AI to business tools. Starter €290/month, Business €590/month, Enterprise on quotation.
- [Autonomous AI agents](https://pugliai.com/agenti-ai.html) / [English](https://pugliai.com/en/ai-agents.html): multi-step workflows across business tools with human oversight of critical steps. From €490/month.
- [Product overview](https://pugliai.com/prodotti.html) / [English](https://pugliai.com/en/products.html)

Local deployment can give the customer control over models, documents and access. External data flows depend on the selected models, connectors and services. On-premise hosting alone does not establish GDPR or EU AI Act compliance; applicable obligations depend on the use case, data, roles, risks and safeguards.

## Guides, methods and sector content

The Italian guide library contains 39 article URLs: 36 current articles and 3 archived editions whose canonical URLs point to their replacements. It has no full English mirror; the English CEO guide is an overview. Sector scenarios are illustrative and are not verified client case studies. Calculator outputs are estimates based on the stated inputs and assumptions, not observed customer results.
